item.title: The Definitive Guide to Open-Source Veterinary Practice Management in 2026: Yosemite Crew vs OpenVPM vs Ababu
item.description: Most veterinary clinics in 2026 are running one of two things: a decades-old desktop application that only works on the front-desk Windows machine, or a per-seat cloud platform that charges every month and holds your patient records hostage. Neither option is acceptable when you are the one legally responsible for those medical records.
